I was active duty military until last year and am currently working two shitty jobs and making use of my GI bill. One of my shitty jobs is working in the diet office of a local hospital. Because we are small all diet orders from patients are taken over the phone or are selected by the patient on a paper menu that we pass out each morning. We calculate sodium for cardiacs/renals/etc and carbs/sugars for diabetics. Obviously whenever the patient selects items that total more sodium and/or carbs/sugar than their doctor approved diets allow we have to call them and negotiate their menu so that their daily amounts are not exceeded.

Tonight I got a call from a woman who has been in our hospital for more than two weeks. Originally she had been put on a non-caloric clear liquid diet (exclusively reserved for diabetics whose blood sugar is so out of control that they can not have regular fucking jello) before she went to a diabetic diet. A week later she had harassed her doctors so well that they moved her to a regular diet. She calls us every meal now.

Today I was only in the office for dinner. The first plate she received was:

8oz 2% milk 8oz iced tea 2 teaspoons sugar 1 lemon wedge 1 c baked potato soup 1 c cottage cheese 8 oz beef brisket with bbq sauce 1/2 c Mac and cheese 1/2 c coleslaw (made with mayo) 1 c size slice of chocolate cake w/ frosting 2 c green beans

These are not our usual portion sizes, but when a patient is on a 'regular' menu they are allowed to choose whatever and as much of each item they would like.

But that's not all. An hour later I got a call from the same woman asking for a second plate of food. If a patient is on a regular menu then they are allowed to do this (for example: most regular menus we serve at the hospital are for mothers that have recently given birth).

Her second plate of food: 8oz bbq brisket 2 c green beans 1.5 c baked potato soup 1 c cottage cheese 32 oz iced tea 8 tsp sugar Lemon

And when I got to her room with her tray not only did she ask for more cottage cheese before even eating what I brought her but she also apologized for being so ravenous - she was on the Adkins/low carb diet. Tee fucking hee.
Working Food Services in a hospital
